title: 5 mistakes first-time kayakers make
hook: Don't get in a kayak before you watch this.
caption: Five beginner mistakes that make your first paddle harder or riskier than it needs to be. Which one would you have made? Send this to your kayak buddy.
altText: A 30-second reel listing five beginner kayaking mistakes: skipping the briefing, paddling with only your arms, holding the paddle wrong, wearing cotton with a loose phone, and ignoring wind and current.

reel.hook: Don't get in a kayak before you watch this.
reel.audio: Voiceover over b-roll. Pick a quiet trending track at low volume.

beats.onScreen: Don't get in a kayak before you watch this
beats.shot: Hard cut on a paddle hitting water

beats.voiceover: One: skipping the briefing. Check your life jacket fits and ask what to do if you tip.
beats.shot: Guide briefing a group, or a life jacket being buckled

beats.voiceover: Two: use your torso. Rotating your body saves your arms.
beats.shot: Side angle of a paddler rotating

beats.voiceover: Three: ask your guide to check your grip and which way the blade faces.
beats.shot: Close up of hands on a paddle shaft

beats.onScreen: 4. Cotton clothes and a loose phone
beats.voiceover: Four: wear quick-dry clothes and keep your phone in a dry bag.
beats.shot: Phone going into a dry bag

beats.voiceover: Five: stay inside the area your guide sets. Conditions change fast.

beats.onScreen: Send this to your kayak buddy
beats.voiceover: Send this to your kayak buddy.

notes: This is general beginner guidance, not a safety manual. Say it the way an instructor would, and if your operator briefs it differently, theirs wins. No prices or place claims in this one, which is why it has no facts to check.
